chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Abdullah ibn Ja'far, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) passed away when he was fifty-four years old, in the year one hundred and eighty-three, and he lived for thirty-five years after Ja'far (عليه السلام).

key_terms.بَعْدَ جَعْفَرٍ: after Ja'far (عليه السلام), indicating the period following his father
key_terms.عَامِ ثَلَاثٍ وَثَمَانِينَ وَمِائَةٍ: the year one hundred and eighty-three
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death
key_terms.مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), the subject of the report

ai.seo_question: When did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام) pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This narration records the passing of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), stating his age at death and the year in which he passed away. It also notes the length of time he lived after Imam Ja'far (عليه السلام), making it a concise biographical report about the Imam's life chronology.

en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Baseer who said,

‘Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty-four years old, in the year one hundred and eighty three (A.H.), and he<sup>asws</sup> lived after (his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>) Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> for thirty five years’.
en.sarwar: 9. Sa‘dibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following. “
Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.) died at the age of fifty five in the year one hundred eighty three. He lived for thirty five years after Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.).”
